'''Adi Vonapa''' was a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] who lived on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]], specifically on the [[Minboosa District]]. He was one of the leaders of the Minboosa [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] [[Rebellion in the Minboosa District|uprising]] alongside [[Rakit]].<ref name="ThePathBelow" />

==Biography==
===Early life===
As a child, Adi Vonapa's entire family was decimated in the midst of [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]]'s endless and bloody clan feuds. The neighboring clan responsible for their destruction captured Adi and sold him along with other children to settle a debt with [[Vobbara Yusinduu]].<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=codex|Adi Vonapa}}</ref>

===Encountering the Alliance Commander===
{{Quote|You probably noticed, but we're trying to get a lot of people out from under the tail of Yusinduu&mdash;our esteemed employer.|Adi Vonapa to the Alliance Commander|<ref name="LotS">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]''</ref>}}
During the [[third Galactic War]], former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Sa'har Kateen]] and the [[Alliance Commander]] traveled to Nal Hutta to steal one of the [[Hidden Chain]]'s shuttles and prevent [[Heta Kol]] from using [[Darth Nul]]'s [[Darth Nul's holocron|holocron]] to create an army of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Mandalorian shock trooper]]s. During a confrontation with Yusinduu, Vonapa managed to save the Commander from a guard attempting to kill them and informed Sa'har and the Commander that the shuttle was in the refinery's hangar, the exact location Vonapa and the workers were attempting to get into. Vonapa and the workers had spent months planning a way to get in, but they lacked many of the people to execute the plan.<ref name="ThePathBelow" />

===Minboosa uprising===
While Vonapa was repairing the freight elevator and Rakit was trying to overload the [[Turret/Legends|turret]] defenses at the refinery, a safety protocol set up by Yusinduu kept overriding their efforts. Vonapa informed the Commander that unless they figure this out soon, a lot of people wouldn't escape the refinery with them. Rakit shared a few ideas and remained hopeful. When everyone were on the landing platform, they fought against Yusinduu. After defeating Yusinduu, the workers boarded the shuttle.<ref name="OutOfTheMire">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Out of the Mire|[[Nal Hutta/Legends|Hutta]]}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Please... it's up to you to protect them. I know you can.|Adi's final words to Rakit|<ref name="OutOfTheMire" />}}
Adi Vonapa first appeared in the [[2024]] Game Update 7.5 of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]'', the eighth digital expansion to the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TORweb">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20240502-0|text=Game Update 7.5 "Desperate Defiance" Recap and VOD}}</ref>

===Gampeplay alternatives===
If Vonapa is helped with repairing the freight elevator, more slaves are able to escape, but he is shot by the turrets and dies shortly before the workers can get on the shuttles. If the turrets are overloaded, Adi lives, but fewer workers are able to escape.<ref name="OutOfTheMire" />
